bills.title: Counter-Terrorism Legislation Amendment (Prohibited Hate Symbols and Other Measures) Bill 2023

name: The majority voted against an amendment moved by West Australian Senator [Michaelia Cash](https://theyvoteforyou.org.au/people/senate/wa/michaelia_cash) (Liberal), which means it failed. ### Amendment text > *(1) Schedule 1, item 5, page 25 (after line 25), at the end of Subdivision CA, add:* > >> *80.2N Review of this Subdivision* >> >> *(1) The Minister must cause a review of the operation of this Subdivision to be undertaken as soon as possible after the end of 2 years after the commencement of this section.* >> >> *(2) The person undertaking the review must give the Minister a written report of the review.* >> >> *(3) The Minister must cause a copy of the report of the review to be tabled in each House of the Parliament within 15 sitting days of that House after the report is given to the Minister.*
